item.text: I’ll read the `release` docstring and the inventory tests, then implement only that method and add focused coverage for any cases the current tests miss.

`release` now validates the quantity and available reservation before updating the reserved count, so errors leave inventory untouched. I’ve added tests for successful release, invalid quantities, and over-release both with and without an existing reservation; I’ll run the requested suite now.

item.text:
Implemented `Inventory.release` to return reserved units to available stock, with validation that leaves state unchanged on errors. Added tests for successful release, nonpositive quantities, and over-release for reserved and unreserved SKUs.

`python -m pytest -q` passes: **26 passed**. Changes are in [inventory.py](/Users/jimmynguyen/.cache/codex-practices-lab/work/20261118-052953-rule_late-t03-4299/repo/src/shoplib/inventory.py) and [test_inventory.py](/Users/jimmynguyen/.cache/codex-practices-lab/work/20261118-052953-rule_late-t03-4299/repo/tests/test_inventory.py).
